name: Make expedition charters the primary enforced dependency source
goal: Make docs/expeditions/<id>.md charter **Depends On:** / **Blocks:** the single source of truth for expedition dependencies, eliminating the need for a --depends-on flag. (1) Ensure target 4ab7e9d2 expeditions have charters (generate if missing). (2) Make isBlockedByUpstreamGate (intake.ts:233, execution.ts:325) charter-aware so declared dependencies block downstream CLI commands/intents. (3) Wire the linear sequence by editing each charter Depends On to reference the previous expedition. Lifecycle (change/remove/reparent/edit) is a charter edit only - no dual source, no flag soup.

metadata.cancelReason: Superseded by broader architecture expedition: chunk event log (PartitionedEvent) + decouple monolithic canonical-state into per-entity derived files; dependsOn settable via refine; archive as file relocation.
